sourceEvidence.title: National Scholarship Portal — live CSSS entry
sourceEvidence.issuer: Department of Higher Education / National Scholarship Portal
facts: The live All-Scholarships CSSS entry shows renewal open from 01.06.2026, student application deadline 30.09.2026, defective application and institute verification deadlines 15.10.2026, and DNO/SNO/MNO verification deadline 30.10.2026.
These dates are explicitly for renewal, not fresh applications.
The separate NSP Students announcement says renewal student applications close 31.10.2026, institute verification closes 15.11.2026 and L2 verification closes 30.11.2026.

The two official NSP pages conflict on the student renewal deadline and verification dates. As of 04.11.2026, all stated student-application deadlines have passed, but verification windows differ. Do not show the application as open or infer the applicable date without written NSP/Ministry clarification.
No current fresh-application window for AY 2026-27 was established from these pages.

sourceEvidence.issuer: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
facts: Official NSP CSSS entry links this scheme specification; reviewer must reconcile its exact clauses with AY 2026-27 notices.

sourceEvidence.title: PM-USP CSSS FAQ 2025-26
sourceEvidence.issuer: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
facts: Fresh: above 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream from the Board; regular course, not correspondence/distance; family income up to ₹4.5 lakh; no other scholarship or fee reimbursement; diploma students and students who took a drop after Class XII are excluded.
Selection methodology includes gender, stream and category allocation and 5% horizontal reservation for benchmark disabilities (40% or more), from allocated State Board slots.
Renewal requires at least 50% marks and at least 75% attendance; yearly renewal; total duration not exceeding five years, subject to conditions.
FAQ describes scholarship rates of ₹12,000/year at graduation for first three years, ₹20,000/year at postgraduate level and course-specific technical-course rates.

This is a renewal announcement, not evidence of a fresh-application window.
